title: Welcome. I'm Yonina,
paragraphs:
*A weaver of ways, integrating various practices and paths of wisdom to facilitate Healing for people, the Earth and all beings.*

The Earth is my greatest teacher, holding space for us to connect to all creatures, life, and ourselves. From my own journey and the deep communion I’ve experienced with others, I believe that while we may not always see the clear steps on the path ahead, when we trust deeply in ourselves, in others, in the universe and take the courage to take a step, any step, we walk in alignment with our process that supports further development.
highlights: Reiki Jin Kei Do | first degree certification (2023)

paragraphs: The natural environments in which I feel most at home represent the complementary polarities of my heritage and upbringing, nourishing different aspects of myself.
Misty moorland and mossy forests nurture my connection to the vibrant unseen worlds of spirit – a place where I can deeply rest my bones and soul, held by the acceptance of the earth.

Vast, dry and silent deserts offer a glimpse of the timelessness of the universe and our own lives, and the ever steady yet ever changing nature of the earth – a place to come with my questions without an expectation for an answer.

Having lived in five countries with multinational grandparents, my personal journey is one of finding home within myself whilst building and nurturing strong and meaningful connections to the people, communities and land around me.
*Healing is coming back home to yourself, getting in touch with and acting from a place of your authentic Being.*
